Senior Civil Juge And Prl.J.M.F.C Court Kolar District K.G.F.
 This Petition, Coming On For Order

S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER 1. Accused nos.1 & 2 in Crime No.25/2024 registered by Robertsonpet Police Station, K.G.F., for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 306 read with 34 IPC, is before this Court under Section 438 Cr.PC.
2.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.25/2024 was registered by Robertsonpet Police Station, K.G.F., for the aforesaid offences against the petitioners herein and another on the basis of the first information received from Rajakumari who is the elder sister of deceased Tamil Selvi.

Apprehending arrest in the said case, petitioners who are arrayed as accused nos.1 & 2 in the FIR, had filed Crl. Misc. No.291/2024 before the jurisdictional Sessions Court, which was rejected on 08.04.2024.
Therefore, they are before this Court.

Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that accused no.3 as against whom similar allegations have been made, has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.6928/2024 disposed of on 29.07.2024.
Petitioners herein are the mother and sister of Rajan who is the husband of deceased Tamil Selvi.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP who has opposed the petition does not dispute the submission made by the learned Counsel for the petitioners.

sentences.text: The material on record would go to show that the marriage of Tamil Selvi with Rajan who is the son of accused no.1 and brother of accused nos.2 & 3 was solemnized on 17.09.2023.
The allegations in the FIR is that though Rajan was taking care of his wife, accused nos.1 to 3 were abusing Tamil Selvi and it is in this background, she had committed suicide on 02.03.2024.
Accused no.3 as against whom similar allegations are found in the first information, has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.6928/2024.

Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioners as against whom similar allegations are found in the first NC: 2024:KHC:32128 information, are entitled for the relief sought in the petition on the ground of parity.

Accordingly,
the following order:
7. Petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.25/2024 registered by Robertsonpet Police Station, K.G.F., for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 306 read with 34 IPC, subject to the following conditions:
1. Petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
each with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. Petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
3. Petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and they shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
Petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future.

Sd/-
